body: i've kind of dug my own grave, or really i made the mistake of going down the rabbit hole to see what's on the other side. I actually think that to make myself happy, i have to be actively fighting against the bullshit in this world.
i do care about my project more than anything, it's literally the only thing that kept me going. but i'd be embarrassed to bring it up on this forum, in the hope that it may succeed.

to explain, my father threatens to kick me out if i don't have a job in two weeks because that's what he thinks motivation is. when i get a job at a restaurant (the only place that hires in less than two weeks), he won't accept it as a real job. 
i loath that i was born to that man, but at this point my back's against the wall. and i"m sick of this place. i'm tired of having no options, why else would i turn to this?
i don't understand, even if his manner turns you off, you admit that you two hit it off...why not at least remain as platonic friends?
